brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested 10 Palestinians Thursday during a series of raids and incursions across the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The operations targeted Nablus and multiple towns and villages in the Bethlehem and Qalqiliya governorates. Local sources said three residents in Nablus sustained injuries from beatings during the enforcement actions.

The arrests marked the latest in a pattern of military operations conducted by Israeli forces throughout Palestinian population centers in the territory. The specific identities and charges against those detained were not immediately disclosed by authorities.
